about: Sample content for the deck sample tool (apps/studio/categories/sample.py), invented people, organisations and figures only. prompt is the customer’s one message; slots holds, per part id, the model’s answer for each time that slot appears. Past its listed instances a repeating slot is drawn as the honest form (heading and ruled lines). A slot whose heading is fixed carries an empty heading, which the finish writes in the language of the deck. Customer slots hold only what the prompt says (figures) or an honest form (topic_only); notes are left to the real model.

prompt.uz: Namuna Mebel kompaniyasi taqdimoti kerak, 10 ta slayd: yangi mijozlarga ko‘rsatamiz. Uy va ofis uchun buyurtma mebel ishlab chiqaramiz, Toshkentda, 2013-yildan. 28 xodim, 340+ buyurtma, 3 shahar. Mahsulotlar: oshxona mebeli, ofis mebeli, garderob. Oshxona mebeli o‘lchovdan o‘rnatishgacha: shkaflar va bar peshtaxtasi, stol usti va furnitura ro‘yxatdan tanlanadi, o‘rnatishni o‘z ustalarimiz bajaradi. Ofis mebeli joylashtirish rejasi bilan: ish stollari va javonlar, qabulxona jihozlari, rejani mijoz tasdiqlaydi. Ish tartibi: o‘lchov, loyiha, ishlab chiqarish, o‘rnatish. Afzalliklar: o‘z ustaxonamiz, usta o‘zi o‘lchaydi, muddat shartnomada yoziladi. Mijozlar: Namuna Hotel, Namuna Klinika, Namuna Maktab. Keys: Namuna Hotel 40 ta xona uchun mebel buyurtma qildi, bitta andoza bo‘yicha seriya yasadik, 3 haftada topshirdik. Telefon: +998 00 000 00 00, Telegram: @namuna_mebel.
prompt.ru: Нужна презентация компании «Намуна Мебель» на 10 слайдов: покажем новым клиентам. Делаем мебель на заказ для дома и офиса в Ташкенте, с 2013 года. 28 сотрудников, 340+ заказов, 3 города. Продукция: кухни, офисная мебель, гардеробы. Кухни от замера до установки: шкафы и барная стойка, столешница и фурнитура выбираются из списка, монтаж делают наши мастера. Офисная мебель с планом расстановки: рабочие столы и стеллажи, мебель для приёмной, план утверждает клиент. Порядок работы: замер, проект, производство, установка. Преимущества: собственная мастерская, мастер замеряет сам, срок записан в договоре. Клиенты: Намуна Отель, Намуна Клиника, Намуна Школа. Кейс: Намуна Отель заказал мебель на 40 номеров, мы сделали серию по одному образцу, сдали за 3 недели. Телефон: +998 00 000 00 00, Telegram: @namuna_mebel.
prompt.en: I need a 10-slide presentation of the Namuna Furniture company to show new customers. We make made-to-order furniture for homes and offices in Tashkent, since 2013. 28 staff, 340+ orders, 3 cities. Products: kitchens, office furniture, wardrobes. Kitchens from measuring to installation: cabinets and a bar counter, the worktop and fittings are chosen from a list, our own craftsmen install. Office furniture with a layout plan: desks and shelves, reception furniture, the client approves the plan. How we work: measuring, design, production, installation. Advantages: our own workshop, the craftsman measures, the deadline is in the contract. Clients: Namuna Hotel, Namuna Clinic, Namuna School. Case: Namuna Hotel ordered furniture for 40 rooms, we made a series from one template, delivered in 3 weeks. Phone: +998 00 000 00 00, Telegram: @namuna_mebel.
